payload.claim: `Ledger.__init__`'s comment calls `migrate` "every caller that predates the rule" passing `events=None`, implying `migrate` is a caller of `Ledger.__init__`. It is not: `saffron migrate` never builds a `Ledger` (see `saffron/record/migrate.py`'s "Never a `Ledger`" docstring and `migrate_and_push`). This repeats the same mischaracterization as the `_append` docstring two lines away in the diff.
